Feel free to pause here and experiment to see if you get better results."}</_components.p>{"\n"}<_components.hr />{"\n"}<_components.h2 id="information-extraction">{"Information Extraction"}</_components.h2>{"\n"}<_components.p>{"While language models are trained to perform natural language generation and related tasks, it's also very capable of performing classification and a range of other natural language processing (NLP) tasks."}</_components.p>{"\n"}<_components.p>{"Here is an example of a prompt that extracts information from a given paragraph."}</_components.p>{"\n"}<_components.p><_components.em>{"Prompt:"}</_components.em></_components.p>{"\n"}<_components.pre data-language="text" data-theme="default"><_components.code data-language="text" data-theme="default"><_components.span className="line"><_components.span style={{

  }}>{"Author-contribution statements and acknowledgements in research papers should state clearly and specifically whether, and to what extent, the authors used AI technologies such as ChatGPT in the preparation of their manuscript and analysis.     color: "var(--shiki-color-text)"
  }}>{"Sentiment: neutral "}</_components.span></_components.span>{"\n"}<_components.span className="line"><_components.span style={{
    color: "var(--shiki-color-text)"
  }} /></_components.span>{"\n"}<_components.span className="line"><_components.span style={{

If you are not sure, we will discuss a few ideas in the upcoming sections."}</_components.p>{"\n"}<_components.hr />{"\n"}<_components.h2 id="conversation">{"Conversation"}</_components.h2>{"\n"}<_components.p>{"Perhaps one of the more interesting things you can achieve with prompt engineering is instructing the LLM system on how to behave, its intent, and its identity.
